这几天既有{s}，也有{s2}，我还在犹豫要不要去看看。

narratives.advice.benign_cyst.en: Cyst: Usually benign, cysts can be followed with an annual ultrasound.
Cyst: Given their typically benign nature, yearly ultrasound surveillance is adequate.
narratives.advice.benign_cyst.zh: 囊肿：建议每年复查超声，观察其变化；多数情况下属良性，无需特殊处理。
囊肿：多数为良性表现，暂不需特殊处置，宜每年通过超声复查随访变化。
narratives.advice.body_fat.en: Raised body fat / visceral fat: Incorporate aerobic and resistance exercise, alongside reduced energy intake, to lower waist circumference.
narratives.advice.body_fat.zh: 体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：建议从饮食和运动两方面着手，减少总热量摄入，规律进行有氧运动与抗阻训练，改善腰围并按期复查。
体脂率/内脏脂肪偏高：可在控制饮食总量的同时坚持有氧运动和抗阻训练，逐步缩小腰围，并定期复查。
narratives.advice.bone.en: Low bone density: prioritize calcium and vitamin D, include weight-bearing exercise, and schedule periodic DXA.
Low bone density: support bone health with calcium and vitamin D; add weight-bearing exercise and periodic DXA.
narratives.advice.bone.zh: 骨量减少/骨质疏松：可补充钙剂和维生素 D，并进行适度负重锻炼，按期检查骨密度。
骨量减少/骨质疏松：日常注意摄入钙剂及维生素 D，配合适当负重运动，定期监测骨密度。
骨量减少/骨质疏松：为维护骨骼健康，建议补钙及维生素 D、适度开展负重运动，并定期复查骨密度。
narratives.advice.brady.en: Sinus bradycardia: In active individuals, this is often seen; cardiology review is advised if dizziness or fatigue occurs.
Sinus bradycardia: Active individuals commonly have this finding, though dizziness or fatigue warrants cardiology review.
narratives.advice.brady.zh: 窦性心动过缓：运动人群中较常见，若没有不适通常不必处理；出现头晕或乏力时，建议就诊心内科。
窦性心动过缓：运动人群常可见此情况，无不适时通常不需处理；如出现乏力或头晕，请至心内科就诊。
narratives.advice.breast.en: Fibrocystic change: No specific treatment is indicated; continue annual breast ultrasound.
narratives.advice.breast.zh: 乳腺增生：日常注意调节情绪、保证作息规律，并坚持每年进行乳腺超声复查。
乳腺增生：保持心境平和，作息安排规律；乳腺超声建议每年复查。
乳腺增生：规律作息、舒缓心情，同时每年复查乳腺超声。
narratives.advice.breast_nodule.en: Breast nodule: if indicated, seek breast clinic review; repeat ultrasound in 6 months.
narratives.advice.breast_nodule.zh: 乳腺结节：可于 6 个月后复查乳腺超声；如有需要，前往乳腺外科就诊。
乳腺结节：请安排 6 个月后进行乳腺超声复查，如有需要可就诊乳腺外科。
narratives.advice.dental.en: Dental: for caries or calculus, see a dentist; brush twice daily and have regular cleaning.
Dental: brush twice daily and have regular cleaning, and see a dentist for caries or calculus.
narratives.advice.dental.zh: 口腔：建议至口腔科处理龋齿及牙结石，并坚持早晚刷牙、定期洁牙。
口腔：如有龋齿或牙结石，可到口腔科就诊处理；日常应早晚刷牙并定期洁牙。
口腔：龋齿、牙结石可请口腔科处理，同时养成早晚刷牙的习惯，并定期洁牙。
narratives.advice.ecg_minor.zh: 心电图轻度异常：建议根据临床表现进一步判断；如有需要，可到心内科就诊复查心电图。
心电图轻度异常：结合临床综合分析，必要时前往心内科就诊，并复查心电图。
心电图轻度异常：请由临床医生结合整体情况判断，视需要到心内科进一步评估并再次检查心电图。
narratives.advice.echo_minor.en: Minor echocardiographic finding: correlate with the clinical picture, as this is often physiological or age-related; control blood pressure.
Minor echocardiographic finding: assess in clinical context, as this may represent a physiological or age-related variation, and keep blood pressure controlled.
narratives.advice.echo_minor.zh: 心脏超声轻度异常：此类表现通常与生理因素或年龄变化有关，宜结合临床情况评估，并注意控制血压，必要时至心内科随诊。
心脏超声轻度异常：若无其他情况，多属生理性或年龄相关改变，可结合临床评估，做好血压管理，必要时由心内科随诊。
narratives.advice.ent.en: ENT: If symptoms develop, arrange an ENT review; avoid irritants and stop smoking.
ENT: Stop smoking and avoid irritants; seek ENT review should symptoms occur.
narratives.advice.ent.zh: 耳鼻喉科：日常饮食宜清淡，避免刺激性食物并戒烟；如有需要，可至耳鼻喉科就诊。
耳鼻喉科：戒烟并避免食用刺激性食物；若有需要，建议到耳鼻喉科就诊。
narratives.advice.eye.en: Eyes: maintain good eye hygiene; consider refraction and spectacles if needed.
Eyes: good eye hygiene is advised, with refraction and spectacles as needed.
Eyes: keep the eyes clean, and obtain refraction and spectacles if indicated.
narratives.advice.eye.zh: 眼科：日常应保持良好的用眼习惯，必要时可进行眼科验光配镜。
眼科：平时注意用眼卫生；如有需要，可至眼科验光并配镜。
narratives.advice.fatty_liver.en: Fatty liver: Follow dietary measures, exercise regularly and maintain a healthy weight; limit alcohol and periodically repeat liver function tests and ultrasound.
Fatty liver: For ongoing monitoring, repeat liver function tests and ultrasound periodically; support improvement with dietary control, regular exercise, weight management and limited alcohol.
narratives.advice.fatty_liver.zh: 脂肪肝：饮食宜清淡适量，配合规律运动以控制体重，并限制饮酒，定期检查肝功能和肝脏超声。
脂肪肝：为改善肝脏状况，建议调整饮食、增加运动，保持适宜体重，减少饮酒，并定期复查肝功能及肝脏超声。
脂肪肝：控制体重可从合理饮食和加强运动入手，同时限制饮酒，定期进行肝功能检查及肝脏超声复查。
narratives.advice.fibroid.en: Uterine fibroid: Should menorrhagia develop, seek gynaecology review; continue annual pelvic ultrasound.
Uterine fibroid: Annual pelvic ultrasound is advised; arrange gynaecology review should menorrhagia develop.
Uterine fibroid: If menorrhagia develops, arrange a gynaecology review; continue pelvic ultrasound annually.
narratives.advice.fibroid.zh: 子宫肌瘤：请每年复查妇科超声；若有月经量增多，需到妇科就诊。
子宫肌瘤：如出现月经量增多，请前往妇科就诊，并每年复查妇科超声。
子宫肌瘤：妇科超声建议每年复查；月经量增多时，应及时看妇科。
narratives.advice.gb_polyp.en: Gallbladder polyp: If it grows or exceeds 10 mm, consult hepatobiliary surgery; continue ultrasound every 6–12 months.
Gallbladder polyp: Schedule ultrasound follow-up at 6–12-month intervals; growth or a size exceeding 10 mm warrants hepatobiliary surgery consultation.
Gallbladder polyp: Ultrasound follow-up is advised every 6–12 months; if growth occurs or size exceeds 10 mm, consult hepatobiliary surgery.
narratives.advice.gb_polyp.zh: 胆囊息肉样病变：请于每 6–12 个月进行超声复查；如病变增大或直径超过 10mm，建议到肝胆外科就诊。
胆囊息肉样病变：超声复查间隔建议为每 6–12 个月一次；发现增大或直径超过 10mm 时，请前往肝胆外科就诊。
胆囊息肉样病变：为观察病灶变化，建议间隔 6–12 个月进行超声复查；如有增大或直径已超过 10mm，可前往肝胆外科进一步诊治。
narratives.advice.gb_stone.en: Gallstones: Maintain a low-fat diet and eat regularly; arrange periodic review, and seek care if right upper quadrant pain develops.
Gallstones: Choose low-fat foods, keep meals regular, and attend periodic reviews; seek care for right upper quadrant pain.
narratives.advice.gb_stone.zh: 胆囊结石：饮食宜清淡少油，按时吃早餐并定期复查；若有右上腹疼痛，应尽快就诊。
胆囊结石：请减少高脂食物摄入，保持早餐规律，并按期复查；出现右上腹痛时及时就诊。
胆囊结石：建议控制脂肪摄入、规律安排早餐，定期检查；一旦出现右上腹疼痛，请及时就诊。
narratives.advice.gyn.en: Gynaecology: Attend for cervical screening alongside regular gynaecological examinations.
Gynaecology: Make routine gynaecological check-ups and cervical screening part of ongoing care.
narratives.advice.gyn.zh: 妇科：可按期进行妇科检查，并开展宫颈细胞学筛查。
妇科：建议将妇科检查和宫颈细胞学筛查纳入定期健康管理。
妇科：定期接受妇科检查，同时进行宫颈细胞学筛查为宜。
narratives.advice.hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌阳性：可至消化内科就诊，由医生评估根除治疗的必要性，并注意分餐。
幽门螺杆菌阳性：建议咨询消化内科，评估是否进行根除治疗；日常注意分餐。
幽门螺杆菌阳性：请结合消化内科就诊评估根除治疗需求，同时注意分餐。
narratives.advice.kidney_stone.en: Kidney stone: Maintain good hydration and regular activity, arrange ultrasound at intervals, and seek care if flank pain or haematuria develops.
Kidney stone: Increase fluid intake and stay active, with ultrasound from time to time; seek care if flank pain or haematuria occurs.
narratives.advice.kidney_stone.zh: 肾结石：日常注意增加饮水并适度活动，按期复查泌尿系超声；若有腰痛或血尿，应尽快就诊。
肾结石：建议保持充足饮水、适量运动，并定期检查泌尿系超声；出现腰痛或血尿时，请及时就医。
肾结石：适当运动并多饮水，定期复查泌尿系超声；如感到腰痛或发现血尿，应及时就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_anemia.en: Anaemia ({items}): review with haematology and investigate the cause; include an iron-rich diet.
narratives.advice.lab_anemia.zh: 贫血（{items}）：为了解贫血原因，可补充含铁食物，并建议到血液科或消化科进一步诊治。
narratives.advice.lab_bmi.en: Overweight/obesity: Increased activity and reduced energy intake are recommended.
Overweight/obesity: Weight management benefits from lower energy intake and more activity.
narratives.advice.lab_bmi.zh: 超重/肥胖：饮食宜合理安排总量，同时加强运动，以逐步减轻体重。
超重/肥胖：建议在控制膳食总量的同时增加运动，促进体重减轻。
narratives.advice.lab_bp.en: Raised blood pressure: Home blood pressure monitoring and a low-salt diet are advised, with cardiology review if the elevation persists.
narratives.advice.lab_bp.zh: 血压偏高：日常宜减少盐分摄入、保持作息规律，并在家测量血压做好记录；若血压持续升高，建议前往心内科就诊。
血压偏高：请注意清淡少盐，规律生活；可在家自测并记录血压，若数值持续升高，请至心内科就诊。
血压偏高：规律作息与低盐饮食有助于管理血压，建议居家测量并记录；如血压仍持续升高，可到心内科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_cardiac.en: Abnormal cardiac markers ({items}): ECG, repeat markers and echocardiography are recommended as part of cardiology review.
Abnormal cardiac markers ({items}): cardiology review is advised, with repeat markers, echocardiography and an ECG.
narratives.advice.lab_cardiac.zh: 心肌标志物异常（{items}）：建议前往心内科进一步评估，复查心肌标志物、心脏超声和心电图。
心肌标志物异常（{items}）：请就诊心内科，完善心电图、心脏超声及心肌标志物复查。
narratives.advice.lab_cbc.en: Abnormal blood count ({items}): arrange a repeat CBC, with haematology review if findings persist.
narratives.advice.lab_cbc.zh: 血常规异常（{items}）：建议择期复查血常规；如有需要，可至血液科就诊。
血常规异常（{items}）：可再次检查血常规，必要时请血液科进一步评估。
血常规异常（{items}）：请安排血常规复查，若有需要，建议前往血液科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_cervical.en: Abnormal cervical screening ({items}): repeat HPV in 12 months, alongside gynaecology review and colposcopy if indicated.
narratives.advice.lab_cervical.zh: 宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：请至妇科进一步评估，必要时接受阴道镜检查；高危型 HPV 检测阳性者，建议于 12 个月后复查。
宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：可先安排妇科评估，必要时进一步行阴道镜检查；若高危型 HPV 检测为阳性，请于 12 个月后复查。
宫颈癌筛查异常（{items}）：请接受妇科评估，并由医生判断是否需要阴道镜检查；若高危型 HPV 检测结果为阳性，复查安排在 12 个月后。
narratives.advice.lab_coag.en: Abnormal coagulation ({items}): exclude sampling artefact before repeating; if the result remains abnormal, seek haematology review.
narratives.advice.lab_coag.zh: 凝血功能异常（{items}）：建议先排查采血因素，之后复查凝血功能；必要时可就诊血液科。
凝血功能异常（{items}）：为确认结果是否受采血影响，建议排除相关因素后再次检测凝血功能；必要时请血液科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.lab_glucose.en: Abnormal glucose ({items}): repeat fasting glucose and HbA1c after diet and exercise measures, with endocrinology review as indicated.
narratives.advice.lab_glucose.zh: 血糖异常（{items}）：为改善血糖情况，宜合理调整饮食并增加运动，复查空腹血糖和糖化血红蛋白；如有需要，可至内分泌科就诊。
血糖异常（{items}）：请注意饮食管理、坚持适量运动，并复查空腹血糖及糖化血红蛋白，必要时前往内分泌科咨询就诊。
血糖异常（{items}）：建议通过控制饮食和加强运动进行调理，同时复查空腹血糖与糖化血红蛋白；若情况需要，建议内分泌科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_hepatitis.en: Positive hepatitis serology ({items}): refer for hepatology review and liver function tests, obtain HBV DNA and ultrasound, and advise screening and vaccination for household contacts.
Positive hepatitis serology ({items}): screen and vaccinate household contacts, and arrange liver function tests, HBV DNA and ultrasound as part of hepatology review.
narratives.advice.lab_hepatitis.zh: 肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：建议复查肝功能、HBV-DNA和肝脏超声，并至感染科或肝病科就诊；家人也建议接受筛查及疫苗接种。
肝炎病毒标志物阳性（{items}）：后续可请感染科或肝病科进一步评估，复查项目包括肝功能、HBV-DNA和肝脏超声；同时建议家人完成筛查及疫苗接种。
narratives.advice.lab_hp.en: H. pylori antibody positive: To determine whether infection is current or past, confirm with a urea breath test; serology cannot make this distinction.
H. pylori antibody positive: Use a urea breath test to clarify whether the serology reflects current or previous infection.
narratives.advice.lab_hp.zh: 幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：抗体检测结果无法鉴别现症感染或既往感染，建议进一步做碳13/碳14呼气试验，确认后再决定是否根除。
幽门螺杆菌抗体阳性：是否为现症感染不能仅凭抗体阳性判断，可行碳13/碳14呼气试验确认，并据此决定是否根除。
narratives.advice.lab_immune.en: Abnormal immunology ({items}): rheumatology review is advised, with joint symptoms taken into account.
narratives.advice.lab_immune.zh: 免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：结合关节症状，建议就诊风湿免疫科并作进一步检查。
免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：如有关节症状，建议到风湿免疫科就诊，进一步检查。
免疫/风湿指标异常（{items}）：建议至风湿免疫科评估，后续检查可依据关节症状安排。
narratives.advice.lab_lipid.en: Dyslipidaemia ({items}): to support lipid control, exercise, manage weight and eat a low-fat diet; repeat lipids in 3–6 months.
Dyslipidaemia ({items}): repeat lipids in 3–6 months, alongside a low-fat diet, weight control and regular exercise.
Dyslipidaemia ({items}): arrange repeat lipid testing in 3–6 months; support this with a low-fat diet, weight management and exercise.
narratives.advice.lab_lipid.zh: 血脂异常（{items}）：宜采取低脂饮食并管理体重，增加运动量，3–6 个月后复查血脂；如有需要，可至心内科或内分泌科就诊。
血脂异常（{items}）：日常应减少脂肪摄入、控制体重并坚持锻炼，建议3–6 个月复查血脂，必要时就诊心内科或内分泌科。
血脂异常（{items}）：建议通过低脂饮食、体重管理及加强锻炼改善情况，并于3–6 个月后复查血脂；需要时可咨询心内科或内分泌科。
narratives.advice.lab_liver.en: Abnormal liver function ({items}): Repeat testing in 2–4 weeks, avoiding alcohol and hepatotoxic drugs until then.
Abnormal liver function ({items}): Arrange repeat testing in 2–4 weeks; meanwhile, avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic drugs.
narratives.advice.lab_liver.zh: 肝功能异常（{items}）：为促进肝功能恢复，请戒酒、避免使用肝损药物，保证休息，2–4 周后复查。
肝功能异常（{items}）：近期应避免饮酒及使用损害肝脏的药物，充分休息，建议在 2–4 周后复查肝功能。
narratives.advice.lab_other.en: Other abnormal results ({items}): after clinical correlation, repeat the assessment.
narratives.advice.lab_other.zh: 其他检验异常（{items}）：可结合临床情况综合判断，建议定期复查。
其他检验异常（{items}）：建议定期复查，并结合临床情况评估。
其他检验异常（{items}）：请结合临床情况随访，定期复查相关指标。
narratives.advice.lab_pancreas.zh: 胰酶异常（{items}）：建议择期复查；若出现上腹痛，宜至消化内科就诊。
胰酶异常（{items}）：可安排复查，伴有上腹痛时请前往消化内科就诊。
narratives.advice.lab_renal.zh: 肾功能异常（{items}）：请适当增加饮水，避免使用肾毒性药物，并至肾内科复查。
肾功能异常（{items}）：注意多饮水并避免服用肾毒性药物，建议到肾内科进一步复查。
narratives.advice.lab_renal_early.en: Raised urine albumin ({items}): possible early kidney damage warrants blood pressure and glucose control, with UACR repeated within 3 months.
Raised urine albumin ({items}): repeat UACR within 3 months and work to control blood pressure and glucose, as this can signal early kidney damage.
narratives.advice.lab_renal_early.zh: 尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：该结果可能与早期肾损伤有关，建议管理好血压、血糖，并于 3 个月内复查尿白蛋白/肌酐比值；必要时至肾内科就诊。
尿微量白蛋白异常（{items}）：可能提示肾脏早期受损，宜控制血压、血糖，并在 3 个月内复查尿白蛋白/肌酐比值；必要时请肾内科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.lab_stool.en: Positive faecal occult blood: endoscopy if indicated, following gastroenterology review.
narratives.advice.lab_stool.zh: 便潜血阳性：可至消化内科进一步评估，必要时完善胃肠镜检查。
便潜血阳性：建议先到消化内科就诊，是否行胃肠镜检查可由医生评估。
narratives.advice.lab_thyroid.en: Abnormal thyroid function ({items}): a consultation with endocrinology is advised.
Abnormal thyroid function ({items}): seek specialist input from endocrinology.
narratives.advice.lab_thyroid.zh: 甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：建议接受内分泌专科评估，并适时再次检测甲状腺功能。
甲状腺功能异常（{items}）：可预约内分泌科进一步诊察，后续根据情况完善甲状腺功能检测。
narratives.advice.lab_tumor.en: Raised tumour marker ({items}): Repeat in 1–3 months, as a mild isolated elevation is often non-specific.
Raised tumour marker ({items}): Consider repeat testing after 1–3 months, as a mild isolated rise is often non-specific.
Raised tumour marker ({items}): If the elevation is mild and isolated, it is often non-specific; arrange a repeat in 1–3 months.
narratives.advice.lab_tumor.zh: 肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：如仅有单项轻度升高，多数情况下临床意义不大；可于 1–3 个月复查，必要时就诊专科。
肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：若升高仅涉及单项且程度较轻，通常临床意义有限，建议 1–3 个月复查，必要时咨询专科。
肿瘤标志物偏高（{items}）：若仅一项轻微超出参考范围，通常不提示明确临床问题；可于 1–3 个月后复测，视情况前往专科评估。
narratives.advice.lab_ua.en: Raised uric acid: follow a low-purine diet, stay hydrated, limit alcohol, and attend periodic reviews.
Raised uric acid: periodic review is advised, alongside a low-purine diet, good hydration, and limited alcohol.
Raised uric acid: maintain hydration and a low-purine diet, limit alcohol, and arrange periodic review.
narratives.advice.lab_ua.zh: 尿酸偏高：日常宜选择低嘌呤食物，少饮酒并增加饮水量，按期复查。
尿酸偏高：饮食以低嘌呤为主，注意控制饮酒、多饮水，并定期复查。
narratives.advice.lab_urine.en: Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): A clean-catch sample should be collected for repeat testing.
Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): Please repeat the test using a clean-catch sample.
Abnormal urinalysis ({items}): To confirm the finding, repeat urinalysis on a clean-catch sample.
narratives.advice.lab_urine.zh: 尿常规异常（{items}）：复查请留取清洁中段尿，必要时可到肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
尿常规异常（{items}）：可先复查清洁中段尿，如有需要再至肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
尿常规异常（{items}）：请规范留取清洁中段尿再次检查；如需进一步评估，可至肾内科或泌尿科就诊。
narratives.advice.lung_function.en: Abnormal spirometry: Smoking cessation and avoidance of dust and irritants are advised, with respiratory review including post-bronchodilator spirometry.
Abnormal spirometry: Arrange respiratory review with post-bronchodilator spirometry; stop smoking and avoid dust and irritants.
narratives.advice.lung_function.zh: 肺通气功能异常：为改善肺部状况，请戒烟并远离粉尘和刺激性气体，至呼吸科复查肺功能（支气管舒张试验）。
肺通气功能异常：请避免吸烟及接触粉尘、刺激性气体，安排呼吸科就诊，复查肺功能（支气管舒张试验）。
narratives.advice.lung_markings.zh: 两肺纹理增粗：常见于吸烟或慢性支气管炎，建议尽早戒烟；必要时请呼吸科进一步评估。
narratives.advice.lung_nodule.en: Small pulmonary nodule: in 12 months, repeat chest CT; stop smoking.
Small pulmonary nodule: stop smoking, and repeat chest CT in 12 months.
Small pulmonary nodule: chest CT should be repeated in 12 months; stop smoking.
narratives.advice.lung_nodule.zh: 肺微小结节：请戒烟，胸部 CT 可在 12 个月后复查。
肺微小结节：戒烟为宜，建议 12 个月后再行胸部 CT 复查。
肺微小结节：为观察结节变化，可在 12 个月后进行胸部 CT 复查，并停止吸烟。
narratives.advice.normal.en: Overall, the findings are reassuring. No significant abnormality found. Maintain a healthy lifestyle and have regular check-ups.
For ongoing wellbeing, follow this guidance: No significant abnormality found. Maintain a healthy lifestyle and have regular check-ups.
narratives.advice.normal.zh: 请继续做好健康管理。本次体检未见明显异常，建议保持健康的生活方式，定期体检。
可将健康管理意见概括为：“本次体检未见明显异常，建议保持健康的生活方式，定期体检。”
narratives.advice.prostate.en: Prostatic hyperplasia: follow up with urology and obtain periodic PSA testing.
Prostatic hyperplasia: arrange urology follow-up, with PSA testing at regular intervals.
narratives.advice.prostate.zh: 前列腺增生：日常宜减少久坐、及时排尿，建议泌尿外科随诊，并定期检查前列腺特异性抗原。
前列腺增生：请避免长时间坐着及憋尿，按建议至泌尿外科随诊，定期复查前列腺特异性抗原。
narratives.advice.surgical_minor.zh: 外科：避免长时间坐着或站立，注意姿势并适度活动，如有需要请到相关科室就诊。
narratives.advice.tcm.en: TCM constitutional imbalance: according to constitution type, adjust daily routine and diet; TCM consultation is an option if desired.
TCM constitutional imbalance: constitution type can guide adjustments to diet and daily routine; consult TCM if desired.
narratives.advice.tcm.zh: 中医体质偏颇：饮食起居宜随体质类型作适当调整，并注意规律作息，必要时前往中医科调理。
中医体质偏颇：建议从饮食和日常起居着手调整，保持作息规律；有需要时可就诊中医科调理。
narratives.advice.thyroid_diffuse.en: Diffuse thyroid change: Thyroid function and antibody tests are recommended alongside endocrinology review.
narratives.advice.thyroid_nodule.en: Thyroid nodule: If indicated, arrange an endocrinology review; repeat thyroid ultrasound and function tests every 6–12 months.
Thyroid nodule: Plan surveillance with thyroid ultrasound and function testing at 6–12-month intervals; arrange endocrinology input if indicated.
narratives.advice.thyroid_nodule.zh: 甲状腺结节：后续可每 6–12 个月进行甲状腺超声及甲状腺功能检查；如需进一步处理，可就诊内分泌科。
narratives.advice.vascular.en: Vascular finding: To support vascular health, keep blood pressure, lipids and glucose controlled, avoid smoking, follow a low-salt, low-fat diet, and have periodic carotid ultrasound.
Vascular finding: Blood pressure, lipids and glucose should be controlled; stop smoking, follow a low-salt, low-fat diet, and have periodic carotid ultrasound.
Vascular finding: Alongside periodic carotid ultrasound, maintain control of blood pressure, lipids and glucose, stop smoking, and follow a low-salt, low-fat diet.
narratives.advice.vascular.zh: 血管相关异常：为维护血管健康，建议将血压、血脂和血糖控制好，戒烟并坚持低盐低脂饮食，同时定期复查颈动脉超声。
血管相关异常：日常应戒烟、采取低盐低脂饮食，并注意控制血压、血脂及血糖，按期进行颈动脉超声复查。
血管相关异常：请重视血压、血脂、血糖管理，避免吸烟，饮食以低盐低脂为宜，并定期接受颈动脉超声检查。
